about: Kinetic doc house look (fixed; founded 2026-10-15 from 4 reference reels: @lightyear.residency, @usvchq, @_otsan, @rit2raj_das; choices not measured from them were made at founding). One house look per style, new components every reel.
world: black-and-white archive: every picture (AI, stock, archive, the user's own footage without the speaker in it) in black and white, ONE warm red accent, grey pages with a vignette for turn lines, warm paper for quotes and the end; the speaker's face stays in colour, as shot

palette.red_note: #D63A2F: white on it 4.7:1, on black 4.5:1, on the grey page 3.4:1 (display sizes only); the ONE accent: the payoff word, the turn word on a page, a label box, a counter, a strike

layout: A: the speaker's plate full screen as shot; the caption block in the chest band (top = max(1130, chin + 60), never past y 1500); full-screen scenes (pictures, pages) <= 2.5 s each. B / C: every moment is a scene; pictures sit in the upper middle (print box <= 980 x 880 centred on y 745), the caption block at top 1240. Nothing in the Instagram top bar (< 220) or bottom UI (> 1500).

type.captions: one centred line; every word pops on in ONE frame at its spoken start, at its final place in the pre-laid line (no fade, no scale, no slide); small words Inter 500, 62 px (shrinks to fit 940 px), white, sentence case, word spacing .32em, soft shadow (never an outline); the line clears with the phrase
type.big_word: one heavy word per idea: Oswald 700 caps, up to 168 px (fits 940 px), on its own line under the small words of its phrase
type.serif_voice: Playfair Display italic 600: quotes, coined terms, names and dates (picture labels 54 px)
type.pages: Inter 600 78 px small words, Oswald 700 caps 210 px big words, Playfair italic 96 px; black block cursor the size of the word, 3 frames ahead
type.typewriter: JetBrains Mono 66 px, ~1 character a frame, a blinking bar cursor, on warm paper
type.labels: red #D63A2F box, Oswald 700 caps white, wipes on left to right in 0.5 s (power3.out); sub-line strip #F4F3EF, Inter 600 48 px ink
type.numbers: Playfair Display 900 upright in red, lining figures (the italic subset draws old-style figures), counting up with a tick per value
type.never: fades, scale-ups or bounces on text; outlined text over pictures; a second display family; per-word colour highlights

insert_frame: print: the sharp picture over its own blurred, darkened copy (the 16:9 -> 9:16 bridge), slow push x1.06
window: the picture in a frame on black, stepping up in three sizes 4 frames apart, then a slow push
full: full bleed, slow push (footage, the hook burst)
polaroids on the grey page, one per word, the camera sliding to the newest (0.35 s eased)

motion.cuts: hard cuts only, on sentence starts or phrase breaks; no dissolves, no flash frames, no glitches; no fade at the end
motion.camera: pictures push slowly (power1.inOut); A: the plate pushes x1.05 over the first 1.1 s (the hook), snap punch-ins of 2 frames on stressed words (<= 3); type never drifts
motion.hidden_cut: one cut hidden in motion per reel (an object crossing the frame, a whip, a zoom into a page): a slot, new each reel

texture: a grain overlay (.07, overlay) and a radial falloff on pages and pictures only; never on the speaker's plate
sound: the voice wall to wall; a flat bed ~19 dB under the voice (music db -19, no ducking) that never stops; SFX only under picture events: whoosh-cine 0.12 s before a picture cut, whoosh-2 into a page, whoosh-3 on a punch-in, a tick per counter value, send-swoosh under a label box, a shutter under a polaroid; never under caption words; nothing under the payoff (quiet())

budgets.A: face on screen >= 65 %, each full-screen scene <= 2.5 s, <= 3 inserts a minute, every look-away covered, nothing on the face (facereel)
budgets.B_C: every moment is a scene; something new every ~1.25 s outside the payoff (pace() reports the longest gaps)
budgets.people: the user's people rules (people-rules.json, empty by default) in every picture; cut-outs and pictures of single people and objects, never crowds or group photos; no classical nudes (the Creation of Adam is out); every picture through broll_vision.py before use

film: the speaker's face as shot: no grade, no filter, no grain, no dim, nothing on it
vary_per_reel: the page treatments and their words
grade_rule: none: the speaker's footage stays as shot; inserts are conformed to it
components_rule: the house look is the type, captions, accents, insert framing and the speaker's face as shot; phone-UI scenes, paper props, polaroid / card / collage treatments, transitions, hook and outro devices are NEW every reel (scripts/components.py plan / check / record, catalog.json)
